tools.name: deploy_to_shiped
tools.description: Deploy HTML/CSS/JS code to Shiped and get an instant public HTTPS URL. Use after generating code with an AI to make it live and shareable.

tools.name: list_shiped_projects
tools.description: List the user's deployed projects on Shiped with their URLs.

tools.name: delete_shiped_project
tools.description: Delete a deployed project from Shiped. Deletion needs approval from the user: if the response asks for it, relay the approval link to the user and retry after they approve.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "delete_shiped_project" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Delete a deployed project from Shiped." → after: "Delete a deployed project from Shiped. Deletion needs approval from the user: if the response asks for it, relay the approval link to the user and retry after they approve."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
